title: Jamanra, the Abomination Boss Guide: Sandstorm, Lightning and Phase Strategy
summary: Complete Act 2 final boss guide covering the Asala sandstorm mechanic, lightning pillar patterns, two-phase strategy and community solutions.
description: Learn how to beat Jamanra the Abomination in Path of Exile 2 Act 2 with sandstorm positioning, lightning pillar patterns and build-specific tips.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Jamanra unleashing lightning pillars aboard The Dreadnought

sections.title: The Two Most Important Things About Jamanra
sections.callout: Find Asala immediately when the sandstorm starts.
calloutDetail: 1. When the sandstorm begins, immediately locate Asala's safe zone and stand behind her.
2. In phase 2 keep lightning pillars and whirlwind from pinning you against the edge.
3. The final boss's official name is Jamanra, the Abomination—not the Risen King.
4. At 1 HP Jamanra stops attacking and triggers an ending interaction with Asala; after it, Act 2 is complete.

answers.label: If you keep dying
answers.text: Check lightning resistance and movement speed first, not just damage output.

answers.label: Sandstorm phase
answers.text: Stand directly behind Asala. She shields you from the sandstorm damage. Kill the undead that approach.

answers.label: Phase two overlap
answers.text: When lightning pillars and whirlwind overlap, move toward the arena centre, not the edge.

facts.note: Main story progression. No separate entry materials required.

facts.label: Fight type
facts.note: Asala provides a safe zone during the sandstorm. Her position is the key survival anchor.

items.label: Lightning resistance (50–75% ideal)
checks: Phase two lightning pillars and melee attacks both deal lightning damage.
items.why: At default resistance, consecutive lightning hits in phase two can kill through full life in two hits.
items.fix: Swap gear for lightning resistance affixes. Even 50% significantly reduces the two-hit kill threshold.

items.label: Effective HP (at least 700)
checks: Physical melee hits in phase one and lightning in phase two both check your total effective pool.
items.why: Below 700 HP, a single unmitigated physical hit followed by any lightning tick is lethal.
items.fix: Prioritise life on body armour and belt. Do not sacrifice all defence for damage.

items.label: Movement speed
checks: Determines whether you can outrun the whirlwind and reposition between lightning pillars.
items.why: Community reports indicate default movement speed makes some phase-two sequences extremely tight.
items.fix: Boot movement speed of 20%+ provides meaningful margin. A movement skill adds further safety.

items.label: Flask management
checks: Save recovery flasks for the phase-two transition and whirlwind sequences.
items.why: Phase one is manageable without flasks. Phase two has overlapping damage that requires active recovery.
items.fix: Do not use all flask charges in phase one. Keep at least two for the phase-two opening.

phases.label: Phase 1: Physical and Lightning Melee
phases.trigger: Fight begins. Jamanra uses melee attacks and a spear throw.
objectives: Learn the lightning melee attack that hits directly in front.
Dodge the spear throw when you are at range.
Do not waste flask charges — this phase is manageable with positioning alone.
notes: Phase one has two main attacks: a lightning melee strike hitting directly in front, and a spear throw when you are at distance.
Stay to the side rather than directly in front or behind. The melee attack has a narrow frontal cone.
The sandstorm event occurs during this phase. When it triggers, immediately find Asala.

phases.label: Sandstorm Event: Asala Safe Zone
phases.trigger: A sandstorm covers the arena. Asala appears and creates a protective zone.
objectives: Locate Asala immediately — she is your only safe zone.
Stand directly behind her to avoid sandstorm damage.
Kill undead that claw toward you within the safe zone.
notes: The sandstorm deals continuous damage across the entire arena except behind Asala.
If Asala is off-screen, look for the golden glow indicator. Move toward it immediately.
The safe zone is small. Do not get pushed out by undead — kill them quickly and hold position.

phases.label: Phase 2: Lightning Pillars and Whirlwind
phases.trigger: Jamanra's HP drops below approximately 50%. Attack patterns intensify.
objectives: Identify lightning pillar placement patterns and move between them.
When the whirlwind starts, move toward centre — not the edge.
Do not let pillars and whirlwind overlap to trap you.
notes: Phase two introduces lightning pillars that strike in sequence across the arena.
The whirlwind attack pushes toward the arena edge. If you are already at the edge when it starts, you have no escape.
The most dangerous moment is when lightning pillars and whirlwind overlap. Pre-position near centre before the whirlwind telegraph.
At 1 HP (rather than a direct kill) Jamanra stops attacking and plays an ending cutscene interaction with Asala; once it finishes the fight concludes and Act 2 is complete.

attacks.name: Lightning Melee Strike
telegraph: Weapon raises with a lightning glow, strikes directly in front.
responses: Stay to the side. The attack hits a narrow frontal cone.
commonMistakes: Standing directly in front to maximize melee uptime.

attacks.name: Spear Throw
telegraph: Jamanra pulls back and aims at ranged characters.
responses: Dodge laterally when you see the wind-up. The projectile travels in a straight line.
commonMistakes: Backing straight up instead of sideways.
notes: Only used when you are at distance. Melee characters rarely see this.

attacks.name: Sandstorm
telegraph: The arena fills with sand. Asala appears with a golden glow.
responses: Move to Asala immediately. Stand behind her. Kill approaching undead.
commonMistakes: Trying to DPS the boss during the sandstorm instead of reaching Asala.
notes: The sandstorm covers the entire arena. Only Asala's zone is safe.

attacks.name: Lightning Pillars
telegraph: Brief ground markers appear before pillars strike in sequence.
responses: Move between pillar positions. Do not stand still. Watch for the next marker.
commonMistakes: Running to the arena edge where there is no room for the next pillar sequence.
notes: Pillars strike in predictable sequences. Learn the pattern to pre-position.

attacks.name: Whirlwind
telegraph: Jamanra begins spinning and moving toward the player.
responses: Move toward the arena centre, then circle around. Do not run straight away toward the edge.
commonMistakes: Running directly away, getting pinned at the wall with no lateral escape.
notes: The whirlwind pushes you toward the edge. If lightning pillars are also active, the overlap is usually lethal.

sections.title: Build-Specific Strategy
paragraphs: Melee: Phase one is your safe damage window. In phase two, only enter after the whirlwind ends and lightning pillars have resolved. Do not chase the boss during pillar sequences.
Ranged: Maintain mid-distance. The spear throw is easy to dodge laterally. In phase two, use the full arena width to create space between pillar positions.
Minion: Your minions can maintain damage during the sandstorm while you focus on reaching Asala. In phase two, keep moving — do not rely on minions to tank the whirlwind.
Low movement speed: Pre-position near centre before phase two begins. The whirlwind is your biggest threat — you must start moving the instant the spin begins, not after it reaches you.
bullets: Community feedback suggests default movement speed makes some phase-two sequences very tight. Boot speed is the single most impactful preparation upgrade.
If damage feels insufficient, verify your single-target setup before attempting the fight — extended fights mean more phase-two repetitions.

entries.question: Is Jamanra impossible at default movement speed?
summary: A player reports that repeated lightning pillars and the whirlwind leave almost no time to attack at default movement speed.
editorialAnalysis: This suggests the guide should separate movement problems from damage problems. The fight is designed to be tight at default speed — boot speed is a legitimate preparation step, not an optional luxury.
officialAnswer: Default speed is survivable but tight. Adding 20%+ boot speed provides meaningful margin. If you cannot dodge consistently, speed is the first upgrade to make.

entries.question: I cannot find Asala during the sandstorm. Where does she appear?
summary: Multiple players report dying during the sandstorm because they could not locate Asala in time.
editorialAnalysis: The sandstorm reduces visibility significantly. Players need a clear indicator description rather than just 'find Asala'.
officialAnswer: Look for the golden glow. Asala appears at a fixed position relative to the arena. Move toward the glow immediately when the sandstorm starts — do not try to finish your current attack.

entries.question: Phase two kills me instantly even with lightning resistance. What am I doing wrong?
summary: A player with 60% lightning resistance still dies quickly in phase two. They describe being caught by overlapping attacks.
editorialAnalysis: The issue is likely positional rather than statistical. Overlapping whirlwind and pillars at the arena edge bypasses resistance checks entirely through physical damage and consecutive hits.
officialAnswer: Check your position when you die. If you are near the edge, the problem is positioning, not resistance. Pre-position near centre and circle rather than running straight.

problems.symptom: Why does the sandstorm kill me before I reach Asala?
directAnswer: You are likely trying to finish an attack or collect loot before moving. The sandstorm damage ramps quickly — move to Asala the instant it starts.
checks: Stop any long animation immediately when the sandstorm begins.
Look for the golden glow indicator.
Do not try to kill undead on the way — reach Asala first, then deal with adds.

problems.symptom: Phase two kills me even with capped lightning resistance.
directAnswer: The lethal combination is usually physical whirlwind damage plus consecutive lightning pillar hits at the arena edge. Resistance alone does not solve a positioning failure.
checks: Confirm where you are when you die — if near the edge, positioning is the issue.
Pre-position near centre before the whirlwind telegraph.
Check effective HP — you may need more total life, not just resistance.

problems.symptom: I cannot find any output window in phase two.
directAnswer: Phase two output windows are short by design. Use one quick skill between pillar sequences. Do not attempt full rotations until you have the rhythm memorised.
checks: Identify the gap between the last pillar and the next telegraph.
Use your fastest single skill, not a long combo.
If no safe gap exists, focus entirely on survival — the fight is not a DPS race.
